welcome_description: This is your control panel. Track total students, mentors, courses, and certificates right here.
nav_add_student_description: Click here to open the student registration form.
welcome-dashboard_desc: Track your total courses, average progress, and attendance percentage right here.
enrolled-courses_desc: These are the courses you can access. Click any course to continue learning.
nav-courses_desc: Click here anytime to see your full course list and progress.
courses-overview_desc: This shows how many courses you have total, completed, and in progress.
nav-results_desc: Click here to view your exam results and report cards.
results-page_desc: Your results appear here as soon as your teachers publish them.
nav-attendance_desc: Click here to open your attendance records.
attendance-summary_desc: These cards show your total classes, present/absent count, and attendance percentage.
welcome-overview_desc: This is your control panel. Track total students, mentors, courses, and certificates right here.
nav-add-student_desc: Click here to open the student registration form.
student-form-name_desc: Enter the student's full name and email — the rest of the profile is optional.
student-form-save_desc: Once the details are filled in, use this button to create the account. A login password is generated automatically.
nav-add-teacher_desc: Click here to open the teacher registration form.
teacher-form-name_desc: Enter the teacher's full name and email — the rest of the profile is optional.
teacher-form-save_desc: Once the details are filled in, use this button to create the account. A temporary password is generated automatically.
nav-users_desc: Open User Management to confirm the student and teacher you just added.
user-list-stats_desc: These counts update instantly as you add students, mentors, and admins.
nav-classrooms_desc: Click here to open Classrooms, where you can group students under a teacher.
create-classroom_desc: Use this button anytime to create a new classroom and assign students to it.
your-courses_desc: Manage your assigned courses — add chapters, assign students, and create assessments from here.
classrooms-header_desc: Each classroom here lists its students so you can manage them.
attendance-controls_desc: Pick a date and classroom, then mark each student present or absent.
results-controls_desc: Choose a classroom, then add results for its students.
nav-requirements_desc: Click here to open classroom resource requirements.
requirements-page_desc: Track and manage classroom resource requirements here.
kpi-overview_desc: Track total institutes, active students, and live users right from the Overview tab.
nav-add-institute_desc: Click here to open the institute registration form and add a new campus.
institute-form-name_desc: Enter the institute's name and contact details. Everything except the name is optional.
institute-form-submit_desc: Once the form is filled in, use this button to register the institute.
institute-created_desc: Your newly created institute now appears here, in the Institutes directory.
nav-add-staff_desc: Click here to open the staff form and create an Administrator for your new institute.
staff-form-role_desc: Select "Admin" to give this person full control of their institute.
staff-form-university_desc: Pick the institute you just created so this administrator is linked to it.
staff-form-submit_desc: Click here to create the account. A one-time password is generated automatically.
credentials-banner_desc: This is the one-time password for your new administrator. It won't be shown again, so save it now.
credentials-download_desc: Click here to save these credentials as a PDF for safekeeping.
nav-subscription_desc: Visit this page anytime to review your plan, usage limits, and upgrade options.
subscription-plans_desc: Compare plans and upgrade whenever your institution needs more room to grow.
nav-dashboard_desc: Your Dashboard brings your learning together in one place: your courses, attendance, results, and announcements at a glance.
